claim: For a finite Gibbs density generated by a self-adjoint H with positive real partition, continuous complex Fréchet derivations D and E, and a self-adjoint first CE readout, the real mixed second log-partition Hessian on two Fréchet-induced directions of a single CE observable equals the dissipative form of the finite CE Onsager system specialized to that same Gibbs density. On the diagonal, this Hessian equals the total-generator entropy production and is nonnegative.

carrier.type: Carrier n = (realDerivationsLane (GibbsOperator n)).L, with GibbsOperator n the existing finite noncommutative operator algebra
conventions: faithfulGibbsDensity uses exp(H) divided by the real traced exponential; no sign change to exp(-H) is implied
the Hessian owner requires self-adjointness only for its first perturbation
the CE curvature reversible form fixes its probe in the second BKM slot and is skew, hence vanishes on the diagonal

smallest_gap.description: Specialize the already proved CE Onsager system to the faithful Gibbs density and its continuous power path. Identify the mixed real Gibbs Hessian with the dissipative component at two Fréchet-induced CE derivation directions, preserving exactly the one-sided self-adjointness hypothesis. Then prove the diagonal total-generator equality and nonnegativity using the already constructed skew reversible term and entropy law.

out_of_scope: Nonvanishing of the reversible curvature probe readout
Time-reversal parity or Onsager-Casimir parity reciprocity
Identification of off-diagonal family-index Hessians (i ≠ j) with a single-observable finite Gibbs CE Onsager system
An explicit pairwise double-sum expansion of the aggregate family quadratic response
Any infinite-dimensional or analytic Gibbs/Onsager theorem
